blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – De La Salle University (DLSU) Manila has suspended in-person and online classes from 1:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. on Monday, Oct. 26. The La Sallian, DLSU’s official student publication, said the announcement came from the Office of the Provost, but it has not disclosed the reasons.
